goal: Operate Watchdog as a secure, resilient, supportable professional SaaS product with governed Intelligence and server-authoritative access.

readiness_score.summary: Watchdog Intelligence Phases 1-8 are now technically promoted and privately canary-accepted in production. The complete 43-migration Intelligence schema is present, all 23 production-allowlisted Edge Functions are aligned to accepted bundles/auth modes, pg_net is installed for the reviewed worker dispatcher, a real production population job completed with governed v5 lineage, retry recovery passed, an identical second job returned cache_hit, and the Cron stop/re-enable path was proven. Customer Intelligence visibility remains off. Supabase leaked-password protection is intentionally deferred on the current Free plan until after at least 10 new users and is not a launch blocker. Remaining public paid-launch gates are production Stripe Live secret configuration plus controlled real-money lifecycle evidence, and external legal/insurance review.

phases.title: Trustworthy core
phases.focus: Server-owned authorization, sourced property data, mobile clarity and reviewed source health.

phases.title: Paid launch readiness
phases.focus: Production Stripe secrets, controlled Live lifecycle evidence and final enrollment decision.

phases.title: Daily professional value
phases.focus: Change Intelligence, saved work, governed exports, evidence lineage and profession-first workflows are production-promoted while customer visibility remains controlled.

phases.title: Team operating system
phases.focus: Organizations, roles, jobs, usage controls, Daily Intelligence and governed team workflows are technically promoted; broad customer visibility remains gated.

phases.title: Resilient platform
phases.focus: Technical production promotion, private canary, cache/retry behavior and scheduler stop path are accepted. Final billing evidence and external legal/insurance review remain; paid Supabase Auth hardening is deferred until after at least 10 new users.

items.detail: Production supports Standard, Agent, Pro, Pro+ and Teams as server-owned tiers. The Standard entitlement correction is promoted and verified against a real Standard production user: Standard is allowed, paid and unknown tiers remain denied. Paid-tier billing/plan mismatches are zero.

Stripe is the selected production provider and all six Live Agent/Pro/Pro+ monthly/yearly Prices are verified. A zero-charge Live trial probe confirmed Stripe reaches the production webhook URL, but the Edge function returned 503 because the production STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and/or STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET are not configured. The probe subscription was canceled immediately with no payment method and $0 charged, and the Live webhook was disabled again. After the secrets are entered directly in Supabase, controlled real-money purchase, failure/recovery, refund and cancellation evidence is still required before enrollment opens.

The staging-accepted Stripe billing-price-catalog, Checkout, Portal and webhook implementations are promoted to production. The webhook includes atomic event claiming, stale-event rejection, plan/cadence/capacity normalization, invoice failure/recovery auditing and refund isolation. Production enrollment remains closed and the Live webhook remains disabled until direct Live secrets and controlled Live acceptance are complete.

The full 43-migration production manifest is present and 23/23 allowlisted Intelligence Edge Functions are aligned to the accepted production bundles/auth modes. pg_net was added as the reviewed runtime dependency for the Vault-backed worker dispatcher. Production canary job 443fc535-5789-495e-8dcc-61680584cae0 resumed from a deliberately preserved fixture error to complete, processed one governed property, created one finding and run a8c40272-b199-402f-ab4b-6fad1de9410e using watchdog-population-worker-v3-governed-assessment-features. Cache probe c87cf0a6-9785-4a6d-96e9-9099a8426a03 returned cache_hit. Scheduler job 2 was disabled, verified inactive and re-enabled at the reviewed five-minute cadence. Customer visibility remains off.

Production authorization is server-owned, Access Boundary CI is green, and Security Advisor findings are classified against docs/property/security-definer-audit-2026-08-17.md. Anonymous public score/telemetry SECURITY DEFINER RPCs and authenticated owner/plan-gated RPCs are intentional API boundaries and are not blanket-revoked. Service/control tables with RLS and no client policy remain fail-closed by design. Leaked-password protection is intentionally deferred on the current Supabase Free plan and is not a launch blocker; revisit after at least 10 new users and a Supabase upgrade.

Access, sensitive workflow, Intelligence and release-control evidence remain server-owned and auditable. Production access_audit_log tier constraints support Standard, Agent, Pro, Pro+, Teams and Developer effective-plan evidence so Agent billing events cannot fail after entitlement mutation.
All 15 production Advisor unindexed foreign-key findings were resolved with explicit covering indexes. A fresh advisor run reports zero unindexed-foreign-key warnings.

The governed 734-marker registry feeds canonical semantic snapshots with source state, freshness, missing/conflict preservation, facts hashes and versioned deterministic scenario lineage. Production Semantic Context/scenario/Analyst support functions are now present on the accepted production bundles while customer visibility remains gated.
Publisher/source monitoring and governed ingestion checks remain review-first and privacy bounded.
Bulk MOD-IV workflows validate and privacy-normalize source data; raw statewide work products remain outside the public application and publication stays explicit.
Sanitized client/service signals aggregate into private incident records; the public status endpoint exposes only broad component state and sanitized resolved timestamps.

NJW-42 isolated restore rehearsal passed with 112 public tables, 6 Auth users and 125 migration-history rows reconciled. Observed RPO was 0 minutes and observed RTO was 3 minutes. The operating objective remains RPO <=24h and RTO <=4h.
A GitHub-hosted public HTTP/content monitor checks the site root and Watchdog entry point. PR validation is included; the 15-minute schedule activates when the workflow reaches the default branch.

Product drafts and methodology boundaries exist, but external counsel review and insurance/entity decisions remain launch work and are not being represented as complete by repository or database changes.

Account exposes server access state, profession personalization, provider-neutral access language, support/status links and authenticated self-service JSON data export. Stripe Checkout and Portal code are production-promoted, while enrollment remains intentionally closed until Live billing acceptance passes.

Agent, Pro and Pro+ pricing is backed by verified Stripe Live prices and production-promoted Checkout code. Paid enrollment remains intentionally disabled until direct production Stripe secrets and real Live lifecycle acceptance are complete.
Disposable staging accounts and GitHub environment secrets exercise Standard, Agent, Pro, Pro+ and Developer authorization without production credentials.

Professional analysis, evidence review, governed population scopes, actions and lineage are production-promoted. A duplicate Data Workbench permissive RLS policy introduced by the Agent-tier follow-up was removed so the granular owner/team policies using can_use_data_workbench() remain the single authorization path.

The production population worker, one-time token dispatcher, resumable retry path, cache reuse and five-minute scheduler stop/restart control are now directly evidenced in production. Broad customer visibility remains gated.
Plan limits, job controls and Intelligence usage events are deployed server-side for the implemented Intelligence workflows; broad customer visibility remains controlled.

Organization/team schema and server boundaries are in production and the accepted Teams functions are deployed. Customer visibility remains feature-gated until commercial/public launch gates are satisfied.

Static access/security contracts, authenticated role gates and hosted Playwright acceptance are required release evidence. Current expanded coverage includes Dashboard, Home, Agent Control, Data Workbench, Intelligence admin, Account, Support and Status at desktop and mobile sizes.
Authenticated support submission uses function-owned Auth validation and the existing private support_requests store. Email fallback is available when sign-in is unavailable.
Account can download an allowlisted JSON export of the signed-in user's Watchdog profile/workspace/Intelligence records without cloning raw statewide data or payment credentials.
Privacy-safe Status and Support pages, status endpoint and operations/incident runbook are implemented. External subscriber notification routing can be added after launch volume justifies it.

Fresh production advisor review is complete. All 15 unindexed foreign-key warnings, all per-row auth.uid() RLS init-plan warnings and the post-promotion duplicate Data Workbench permissive-policy warnings are resolved. Current Performance Advisor output contains only informational unused-index observations, intentionally retained until real production usage exists.
Versioned models, features, evidence, semantic snapshots, calibration and deprecation controls are in place; ongoing marker validation remains normal product operations.

After Watchdog has at least 10 new users, upgrade Supabase and enable leaked-password protection as a post-launch security hardening step. This is explicitly not a blocker for the initial Free-plan launch and is tracked in NJW-217.
Useful enhancement but not required for the technically accepted production Intelligence platform.
Current responsive/focus/reduced-motion contracts are tested in core surfaces; a broader WCAG audit remains ongoing product quality work.
Core product telemetry exists; final paid-funnel reporting should be validated against the accepted Live Stripe lifecycle before public enrollment.
Security answers, W-9/invoicing path and organization terms remain business-operations work before broad firm procurement.
